title: AlertCatalogSource
description: One source an alert can watch: its kind, and the filters and triggers it supports, by name.

sourceKind.description: Source names look alike but mean different things. Entity: the change events of one asset type. Activity: collaboration items. All: the wildcard.

name.description: Name of the source, as alerts store it.

containerEntities.description: Entity types that can contain this source, so a name filter can be scoped to descendants.

filters.description: Names of the filters this source supports, in the order they are offered.

triggers.description: Names of the triggers this source supports, in the order they are offered.

removedFilters.description: Filters this source supported in an earlier release. Never offered; kept so alerts saved then still build.

removedTriggers.description: Triggers this source supported in an earlier release. Never offered; kept so alerts saved then still build.

labels.description: Labels by filter or trigger name, where this source calls one differently from its definition.

parameters.description: Settings of a filter or trigger for this source, by its name, such as which fields count as the schema of this asset type.

removed.description: A source of an earlier release. Never offered; kept so alerts saved then still build.
